description: Loch Panel (Docker server management: containers, websites, SFTP, managed services, private networks), the Loch CLI with its MCP server, Loch S3 (self-hosted S3-compatible object storage), Loch Lambda Runtime (runs handlers written for AWS Lambda in plain Docker containers), Loch Queue Manager (Traefik waiting-room plugin) and Loch Deploy (deployment server for GitLab CI with OIDC tokens).
rules: Configure a server with `loch config <name> --url <api-url>`, select it with `loch use <name>`, then run `loch login` before any other loch command or the MCP server.
The API key scopes decide what loch and its MCP tools may do; websites, SFTP, services, networks and users require an admin profile.
Passwords are never returned by the MCP tools: the user runs `loch services reset-password` in a terminal.
Database deletion and published ports are CLI-only, not available through MCP.
When contributing to Loch Panel, pull Docker images from mirror.gcr.io, never from Docker Hub directly.
